title: FACT CHECK: Video of priest ‘berating’ impeachment prosecutors is manipulated
summary: The video splices together footage from a June 2022 Mass attended by Duterte and a clip from a July 2026 Mass attended by impeachment prosecutors, with audio taken from a third, unrelated video…

blocks.text: Claim: A video shows a priest criticizing members of the prosecution team in the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte during his homily.
Why we fact-checked this: The claim appears in a November 22 Facebook Reel on the page “The Filipino Connection.”

In the video, the Mass celebrant, who was shown in the first three seconds, can be heard saying: “Tayong mga Katolikong Pilipino, simba nang simba pero corrupt, ‘di ba, simba nang simba pero corrupt, simba nang simba pero magnanakaw… That’s the very reason kasi we are not serious about becoming saints, takot tayo. Ang totoo lahat tayo tinatawag na maging banal, and that is the very reason.”

(We Filipino Catholics, we like going to church but we are corrupt, aren’t we, we like going to church but we are thieves…That’s the very reason, because we are not serious about becoming saints, we are scared. The truth is we are all called to be holy, and that is the very reason.)

The video then cuts to a clip showing several members of the prosecution in Duterte’s impeachment trial: Batangas 2nd District Representative and House lead prosecutor Gerville Luistro, Mamamayang Liberal Party-list Representative Leila de Lima, San Juan City Representative Ysabel Maria Zamora, private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan, and Manila 3rd District Representative Joel Chua.
The video’s caption states: “Prosecution sermoned by priest and the guilt in their faces is so profound that each word hit their bodies and kept them in silence.”
As of writing, the video has around 11,800 reactions, 1,800 comments, 6,100 shares, and 612,000 views.

The facts: The video from “The Filipino Connection” is edited. It combines video clips from two separate Catholic Masses with an audio overlay taken from a third, unrelated video, to make it look like the Mass celebrant is addressing the impeachment prosecutors.

The footage in the first three seconds of the video was taken during a Mass at the San Pedro Cathedral in Davao City on June 19, 2022, which was attended by then Vice President-elect Duterte. It was officiated by Archbishop Romulo Valles from the Archdiocese of Davao; he can be seen in the RTVM live stream of the Mass.

The succeeding clip, showing the impeachment trial prosecutors, was taken from a Mass held at the Chapel of the Nativity of the Immaculate Conception Cathedral in Cubao, Quezon City on July 2, 2026 — days before the impeachment trial started on July 6. The prosecutors can be seen in the House of Representatives’ footage of the full Mass.

Although the edited video by “The Filipino Connection” makes it appear that Valles made the remarks calling out the hypocrisy of “corrupt” churchgoers, this statement did not come from him. It was actually made by Fr. Ric Eguia during a November 1, 2026 Mass. The audio from Eguia’s homily was overlaid on the footage of the two separate Masses to create the misleading impression.

Similar posts using the audio from Eguia’s homily have been repurposed in widely circulating videos targeting other public figures. Some use the same 2022 video of Valles, while others feature clips from different Masses. These posts also incorporate unrelated videos of Duterte and President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to create the impression that the priest was berating them.
